children: Creative Medical Technology entered into a Stock Purchase Agreement to increase its ownership in BioDefense to 80%. The company acquired 4,000,000 BioDefense shares from Creative Acquisition for $200,000 in cash and 1,000,000 shares of Creative Medical Technology common stock. Following the deal, Creative Medical Technology holds 16,000,000 BioDefense shares, while Creative Acquisition retains 20%. The share issuance to Creative Acquisition was completed via a private placement under Section 4(a)(2).
: Increase ownership and control of BioDefense
